method: Single-factor (one-layer-at-a-time) design relative to a common baseline. Reuses real historical usage_log.json/layer_ablation.json data wherever available; all other cells are explicit, unmeasured placeholders (measured_or_reused == 'missing_not_yet_measured'), never fabricated.
limitation: This 5-configuration design can report each layer's ISOLATED marginal cost (configuration total minus baseline total) and a single lumped interaction/residual term for all three layers together, but CANNOT uniquely attribute pairwise interactions (e.g. code+design only, without prompt) -- that would require 3 additional 2-layer configurations (a full 8-configuration factorial design). Isolated per-layer deltas must NOT be assumed additive; the measured all_three total is compared against the sum of isolated deltas explicitly, and any gap is reported as an unattributed interaction/noise term, not silently reconciled.
